thread:
mohit: hey finance — quick Q from my BCN trip. Corporate card charged a 3.5% foreign transaction fee on the hotel folio (hotel added it as a separate line). charge is EUR 15.35. should we get that refunded or do I file for reimbursement?

emma: do you have the hotel folio or the card statement line? if it shows the merchant applied the fee we can reimburse; if it’s a bank FX markup from the card issuer we usually dispute with the card provider. can you attach a screenshot? :mag:

mohit: attaching snippet here — see last line `CITYHOTEL BCN - EUR 438.00` and then `FX PROCESSING FEE - EUR 15.35` on the Ramp statement. card used: corp ending 4321. hotel folio (photo): "Room 3 nights, total EUR 438.00" (folio doesn’t call out the fee, was added at settlement).

expense-bot: Please upload the original folio and card stmt to Ramp under the expense: "BCN - CityHotel - 2025-06-12" so finance can process. Missing docs will delay disputes.

emma: thanks — if the folio doesn’t show the fee, it looks like the merchant added a post-authorisation processing fee at settlement. two paths: 1) we can ask Ramp to open a dispute with the card issuer (takes 7-21 days) OR 2) reimburse you now and recover from vendor later. which do you prefer?

mohit: prefer we try dispute first — don’t want to mess with my per-diem math.

sam: +1 to dispute first. if it’s a vendor-side fee we should push it back. ping me if finance needs manager sign-off to reimburse temporarily.

emma: ok i’ll start a dispute with Ramp — need: 1) uploaded folio, 2) last 4 of card (4321), 3) card transaction id if you have it. i already see the statement screenshot, but we need the folio in the expense.

mohit: done — folio uploaded to Ramp and I added the statement screenshot. Transaction ID is `TXN-7890123` (on the Ramp activity).

emma: perfect. opened dispute ticket #FIN-2025-482 with Ramp and assigned to card ops. I’ll follow up here once they respond. if they deny, we’ll reimburse you and then try vendor recovery. :thumbsup:

alice: FYI travel ops — a heads-up to ask hotels to include all fees on folio, saves this back-and-forth. I’ll update the travel guidance doc.

expense-bot: Expense report status updated: "Docs received — dispute initiated". Expected resolution window: 7-21 business days.

mohit: great, thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help.

emma: np. will update thread once Ramp gets back or if we need manager sign-off.
